lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately 10 identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Blob diameter and inter-blob distance increase towards the dorsal midline, with smaller, higher-density clusters located near the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, creating a distinct grid-like pattern across the central and posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition (bright superior edge and shadowed inferior edge) extending along the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly within its boundaries.
